title: AI Governance Control Specification Schema
description: JSON Schema specification for machine-readable AI governance controls across universal, conditional, and parameterized categories.

id.description: Permanent canonical control identifier adhering to the enterprise scheme.

title.description: Concise human-readable name of the governance control.

objective.description: Clear statement of the intended risk mitigation or compliance objective.

domain.description: The standardized governance domain governing this control.

type.description: Control classification: universal (applies to all AI systems), conditional (triggered by declared characteristics), or parameterized (context-specific threshold values).

applicability_condition.description: Declarative predicate governing when this control activates. Universal controls specify always true.

manifest_path.description: Dot-notation JSON path within the project manifest evaluated by the resolver (e.g. 'ai_system_profile.declared_characteristics.executes_tools_or_code').

target_value.description: The expected value that triggers control applicability.

description.description: Human-readable summary of the applicability rule.

parameters.description: Configurable parameters and numeric thresholds associated with this control.

default_value.description: Default parameter value applicable in the baseline.

monotonicity.description: Merge rule behavior when overlays adjust this parameter.

approval_authority_placeholder.description: Placeholder designating the governance role authorized to modify this parameter (e.g. '[ROLE: Model Risk Officer]').

lifecycle_stages.description: AI lifecycle stages in which this control is verified or enforced.

enforcement_points.description: System architecture locations where policy checks are executed.

check_type.description: Operational verification mechanism: automated (zero human subjectivity), manual (expert judgment), or hybrid (automated checks requiring sign-off).

mode.description: Failure enforcement posture: blocking (halts pipeline/deployment), advisory (warns developer without halting), or review (routes to human reviewer).

evidence_required.description: Artifacts that must be generated, collected, and attested to satisfy this control.

eligible.description: Whether teams may request a time-limited exception against this control.

statutory_prohibition.description: If true, this control represents a non-derogable legal obligation; exceptions cannot be granted under any circumstance.

minimum_compensating_controls.description: Mandatory safety counter-measures required before an exception may be considered.

mapping_status.description: Must be 'verified' only when verified against authoritative primary source; otherwise 'mapping to verify'.

reference_mappings.description: Cross-framework mappings to authoritative standards and regulatory requirements.

owner_placeholder.description: Designated enterprise role placeholder accountable for the control (e.g. '[ROLE: Head of AI Safety]').

version.description: Semantic version of this control specification.

status.description: Current lifecycle status. All newly generated controls start in DRAFT.

borderline_placement_rationale.description: One-line justification required if this control was a borderline candidate between baseline and overlay.
